description: Fetch a URL and get the response as sent: HTTP status, content type, key headers, the redirect chain, timing and the raw body (HTML, JSON, XML or text, up to 500 KB). For agents that parse pages or call public JSON endpoints themselves; use /web/extract for clean Markdown. Public http(s) URLs only. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.
name: web_fetch
